```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

## Purpose
Scrape Oxford, OH listings from Rentler. The search page lists links to each listing, and each listing page stores its details as JSON.

## Check permission
```{r robots}
robotstxt::paths_allowed(paths = "/places-for-rent/oh/oxford", domain = "rentler.com")
```

## Get the listing links
```{r links}
rt = rvest::read_html("https://www.rentler.com/places-for-rent/oh/oxford")
rt_json = rt |> rvest::html_elements("script[type='application/ld+json']") |> rvest::html_text()
rt_data = jsonlite::fromJSON(rt_json, flatten = TRUE)
rt_items = rt_data[["@graph"]][["itemListElement"]][[3]]
nrow(rt_items)
```

## Function to read one listing page
```{r function}
get_rentler = function(url) {
  pg = rvest::read_html(url)
  blocks = pg |> rvest::html_elements("script[type='application/ld+json']") |> rvest::html_text()
  graph = jsonlite::fromJSON(blocks[1], flatten = TRUE)[["@graph"]]
  listing = graph[1, ] |>
    dplyr::select(dplyr::where(\(x) !is.list(x))) |>
    dplyr::mutate(dplyr::across(dplyr::everything(), as.character))
  listing$link = url
  Sys.sleep(1)
  return(listing)
}

get_rentler(rt_items$item[1]) # test on one
```

## Scrape all listings and save
```{r scrape}
rentler_raw = purrr::map_df(.x = rt_items$item, .f = purrr::possibly(get_rentler, otherwise = NULL)) |>
  dplyr::mutate(scrape_date = Sys.Date())
readr::write_csv(rentler_raw, "data/rentler_oxford_raw.csv")

nrow(rentler_raw)
dplyr::glimpse(rentler_raw)
```

## Clean
```{r clean}
rentler_raw |>
  dplyr::transmute(
    source         = "Rentler",
    address        = offers.itemOffered.address.streetAddress,
    zipcode        = offers.itemOffered.address.postalCode,
    lat            = as.numeric(offers.itemOffered.geo.latitude),
    lng            = as.numeric(offers.itemOffered.geo.longitude),
    property_type  = offers.itemOffered.accommodationCategory,
    price          = as.numeric(offers.price),
    price_unit     = offers.priceSpecification.referenceQuantity.unitCode,
    bedrooms       = as.numeric(offers.itemOffered.numberOfBedrooms),
    bathrooms      = as.numeric(offers.itemOffered.numberOfBathroomsTotal),
    sqft           = as.numeric(offers.itemOffered.floorSize.value),
    date_available = as.Date(offers.availabilityStarts),
    date_posted    = as.Date(datePosted),
    description,
    link,
    scrape_date
  ) -> rentler_clean

dplyr::count(rentler_clean, property_type)
rentler_clean |> dplyr::select(address, property_type, price, bedrooms, sqft)
readr::write_csv(rentler_clean, "data/rentler_oxford_clean.csv")
```
